examples.trans: I'll stay at home.

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'to', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Димочка, ну не расстраивайся ты так.
examples.trans: Dimochka, well do not get so upset.

examples.text: Я новый контракт не могу подписать.
examples.trans: I cannot sign a new contract.

examples.text: Сейчас это уже не ресторан, а печка.
examples.trans: Right now it is no longer a restaurant, it is a furnace.

meanings.note: Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'came', paired with 'приходить'.

examples.text: Сейчас придёт охрана.
examples.trans: Security will be here any moment.

examples.text: Я приду завтра.
examples.trans: I'll come tomorrow.

examples.text: Не надо, Самсон. Сейчас придёт охрана.
examples.trans: Don't, Samson. Security will be here any second.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'she', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Дима, ты же всё-таки профессиональный актёр.
examples.trans: Dima, you are a professional actor after all.

examples.text: Она целых восемь миллионов стоит, и не моя.
examples.trans: It costs a full eight million, and it is not mine.

examples.text: Можно через спутник определить, где она находится.
examples.trans: We can locate where it is via satellite.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'were crying', paired with 'заплакать'.

examples.text: Она плакала, что папу никуда не возьмут.
examples.trans: She cried that nobody would hire her dad anywhere.

examples.text: Ну не плачь ты.
examples.trans: Please don't cry.

examples.text: Почему девочка плачет?
examples.trans: Why is the little girl crying?

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'daddy' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Она плакала, что папу никуда не возьмут.
examples.trans: She cried that nobody would hire her dad anywhere.

examples.text: Привет, папа!
examples.trans: Hi, Dad!

examples.text: Папа дома.
examples.trans: Dad is at home.

meanings.en: nowhere, not anywhere (direction/destination, used with не or нет)
meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'nowhere', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Она плакала, что папу никуда не возьмут.
examples.trans: She cried that nobody would hire her dad anywhere.

examples.text: Слушайте, да не нужно вам никуда ехать.
examples.trans: Listen, you don't need to go anywhere.

examples.text: Да никуда я не пряталась!
examples.trans: I wasn't hiding anywhere!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'not', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Димочка, ну не расстраивайся ты так.
examples.trans: Dimochka, well do not get so upset.

examples.text: У меня сейчас сплошные нервы и стресс.
examples.trans: I have nothing but nerves and stress right now.

examples.text: Я новый контракт не могу подписать.
examples.trans: I cannot sign a new contract.

meanings.note: Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to take', paired with 'брать'.

examples.text: Возьмите на работу Галилея.
examples.trans: Go and hire Galileo.

examples.text: Возьми деньги.
examples.trans: Take the money.

examples.text: Вот и возьмите на работу Галилея.
examples.trans: Then go and hire Galileo.

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Просто Катя попросила, и я его пристроила.
examples.trans: Katya simply asked, and I gave him a job.

examples.text: Или просто попроси у шефа повышения.
examples.trans: Or simply ask the chef for a promotion.

examples.text: Даже не мечтай, просто забудь об этом.
examples.trans: Do not even dream of it, just forget about it.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'then', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Хочешь найти шляпку, тогда следуй подсказкам.
examples.trans: If you want to find the hat, follow the clues.

examples.text: Тогда подумай, как получить прибавку.
examples.trans: Then think about how to get a raise.

examples.text: Тогда шеф точно повысит твою зарплату.
examples.trans: Then the chef will definitely raise your salary.

meanings.note: Prefix 'ис-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'кренне').

examples.text: Я тебя просто тогда искренне пожалела.
examples.trans: I simply felt sorry for you back then.

examples.text: Марина Сергеевна, я вам искренне сочувствую.
examples.trans: Marina Sergeyevna, I sincerely sympathize with you.

examples.text: Искренне благодарю.
examples.trans: I sincerely thank you.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'жалеть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'felt sorry for', paired with 'жалеть'.

related.gloss: not to felt sorry for (negated infinitive)

examples.text: Я тебя просто тогда искренне пожалела.
examples.trans: I simply felt sorry for you back then.

examples.text: Катя попросила, я тебя пожалела.
examples.trans: Katya asked, I felt sorry for you.

examples.text: Ты ещё пожалеешь!
examples.trans: You'll be sorry!

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'просить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'asked', paired with 'просить'.

examples.text: Просто Катя попросила, и я его пристроила.
examples.trans: Katya simply asked, and I gave him a job.

examples.text: Или просто попроси у шефа повышения.
examples.trans: Or simply ask the chef for a promotion.

examples.text: Катя попросила, я тебя пожалела.
examples.trans: Katya asked, I felt sorry for you.
